problem.text: Every Job.receive_logits call checked logit batch size, prefill completion and sequence liveness before sampling.

reasoning.text: Removing these repeated checks plausibly reduces Python-side sampling overhead, at the cost of local invariant diagnostics. Performance motivation is an inference, not a measured speedup.

impact.text: The three assertions become comments; sampler arguments, token constraints and return handling are unchanged. Invalid state no longer fails at these particular checks.

source_notes.text: The root generation entry was read. It records the ready-sequence invariant and an incomplete optional-output implementation in receive_logits.

Issue #12, “Qwen2.5 Coder 0.5B Instruct | ValueError: Unsupported type in stop_conditions,” reports a constructor failure and discusses using chatml instead of llama3 mode. Its relationship here is only inferred from the shared job.py path and matching constructor exception; the task does not change that code.

limitations: No generation workload or GPU benchmark was executed; overhead reduction and output equivalence are unmeasured.
The scalar check exercises optional-return control flow only, not repository sampling or tensor operations.

claims.text: The removed prefill check scans sequences for kv_position == len(sequence_ids) - 1: the final input token remains for decoding. The liveness check separately scans seq.live; the shape check compares logits' first dimension with the sequence count.

Whole-tree search finds one active direct caller, Generator.iterate_gen, and one commented threaded call. iterate_gen excludes unready jobs while constructing its batch, maps sequence rows back to each job and passes one token-position slice per sampling call. These upstream controls remain; removing local assertions does not introduce support for arbitrary shapes or unready jobs.

The inherited optional-output failure remains: enabled probability or top-token branches still contain only pass, leaving return variables unassigned. The task changes neither these branches nor their caller.

findings.description: An inherited optional-output failure persists in the modified function.
findings.trigger: Job.receive_logits reaches its return with return_probs=True or return_top_tokens greater than zero.
findings.expected_behavior: Return requested probabilities or top-token arrays alongside the sampled token.
findings.actual_behavior: The enabled branches assign nothing, so tuple construction raises UnboundLocalError. This reaches the active Generator.iterate_gen caller before receive_sample can consume the result.

verification.description: Transcribed conditional assignments returned the default tuple with both options disabled and raised UnboundLocalError for each enabled option.
verification.limits: Scalar Python model, not execution of Job or its sampler.

annotation.summary: Comments out three sampling-entry assertions, trading local diagnostics for less repeated checking; an inherited optional-output failure remains.
